display.purpose: Page titles, brand wordmark, primary h1 headings.

headline.purpose: Section titles within the admin panel (h2).

label.purpose: Badges, nav items, button text, metadata.

shadows.name: gold-glow
shadows.purpose: Card hover state and active primary button. Never at rest.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Input focus ring — gold whisper glow.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default transition easing for state changes.

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Standard: card hover lift, nav item highlight, input focus.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Below: sidebar becomes horizontal tabs, grid drops to 1 col.

breakpoints.purpose: Above: sidebar is 250px fixed, grid auto-fills.

breakpoints.name: wide

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action per surface. Gold gradient, black text, lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D4AF37, #B8860B); color: #000; border: none; padding: 0.8rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F3CA47, #D4AF37); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.4); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.5); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost button for secondary actions. Near-invisible at rest.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); color: #F4F4F6; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); padding: 0.8rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(244, 244, 246, 0.2); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Inline compact danger action — deletes, removes.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: rgba(139, 28, 49, 0.2); color: #FF6B6B; border: 1px solid rgba(139, 28, 49, 0.5); padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.85rem; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: rgba(139, 28, 49, 0.4); border-color: #FF6B6B; }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Primary content container. Glassmorphism surface, lifts 2px on hover with gold glow.
components.css: .ds-glass-card { background: rgba(22, 21, 30, 0.6); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); border-radius: 16px; padding: 1.5rem; transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease; } .ds-glass-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 30px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.15); border-color: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form input. Dark fill, ghost border, gold focus ring.
components.css: .ds-form-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; } .ds-label { font-size: 0.9rem; color: #A0A0A8; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); color: #F4F4F6; padding: 0.8rem 1rem; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; transition: all 0.3s ease; outline: none; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #D4AF37; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.15); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #A0A0A8; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar navigation item. Transparent at rest, gold-tinted on active/hover.
components.html: Dashboard
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.8rem; padding: 0.8rem 1rem; border-radius: 8px; color: #A0A0A8; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; transition: all 0.3s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item--active { background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.15); color: #D4AF37; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Pill-shaped status indicator. Three semantic variants: success (available), warning (low stock), info (partial).
components.html: Available Low Stock Partial
components.css: .ds-badge { padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; display: inline-block; } .ds-badge--success { background: rgba(46, 139, 87, 0.2); color: #4ade80; border: 1px solid rgba(46, 139, 87, 0.4); } .ds-badge--warning { background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.15); color: #D4AF37; border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3); } .ds-badge--info { background: rgba(65, 105, 225, 0.2); color: #60a5fa; border: 1px solid rgba(65, 105, 225, 0.4); }

components.name: WhatsApp CTA
components.description: Full-width catalog inquiry button. WhatsApp green, always inside a product card.
components.css: .ds-btn-whatsapp { width: 100%; background: #25D366; color: #fff; border: none; padding: 0.7rem; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-whatsapp:hover { background: #1DAE51; transform: translateY(-1px); }

narrative.overview:
Udupu is a dark, jewel-toned boutique catalog that makes every saree and dress feel like it belongs in an intimate high-end showroom. The near-black backgrounds recede completely, letting product imagery and the signature gold accent carry all the visual weight.

The interface is deliberately understated — muted matte surfaces, razor-thin glass borders, barely-there chrome — so that the gold moments (CTAs, nav highlights, prices) land with maximum authority.

Motion is subtle and purposeful — a 0.3s ease on nearly everything, cards lifting 2px on hover, elements fading in with a 10px upward drift. The system is never flashy; it is merely, unfailingly precise.
keyCharacteristics: Single gold accent; every other color serves a functional role
Outfit typeface — geometric, modern, and neutral
Glassmorphism cards with backdrop-blur as the primary elevation metaphor

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Gold is the only accent color used decoratively. Every other color (green, red, blue) is strictly functional — a status signal, never a style choice.

rules.name: The Gradient Headline Rule
rules.body: Brand headings use the gold-to-bright-gold linear gradient via background-clip: text. This treatment is reserved for the logo wordmark and the most prominent heading on each surface — never repeated more than once per screen.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces carry no shadow at rest. The gold glow appears only on hover or interaction, making its appearance feel like the surface responding to your intent, not decoration.

dos: Do use --primary-gold (#D4AF37) as the singular accent — on no more than one primary action and one text highlight per screen.
Do apply backdrop-filter: blur(12px) to every floating surface (cards, modals, dropdowns) — it is the defining depth metaphor.
Do use the translateY(-2px) + gold glow combination for every interactive card hover.
Do lock product image aspect ratio to 4/5 (portrait) to preserve saree and dress photography proportions.
Do use the Outfit font across all text.
donts: Don't introduce new decorative accent colors. Green is for sold/success, red is for danger, blue is for revenue.
Don't add box-shadows to elements at rest.
Don't use the gold gradient text treatment on more than one heading per screen.
Don't collapse backdrop-filter to zero on glass cards without providing a fallback background.
